# Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd (RC 1441429)

> Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd (CAC Registration No: RC 1441429) is a duly incorporated Nigerian real estate and total facility management firm headquartered in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, operating across Port Harcourt, Lagos, Abuja, and nationwide. We specialize in residential estate governance, property administration, property sales, certified property valuation, commercial facility operations, preventative building maintenance, and utility management.

## Core Services (10 Disciplines)
1. **Estate Management** (`/services#estate-management`): Comprehensive administration for residential estates and gated communities—bylaws enforcement, transparent service charge accounting, perimeter security, and common area maintenance.
2. **Property Management and Administration** (`/services#property-management`): End-to-end landlord and tenant management—rigorous tenant screening, legal lease documentation, automated rent collection, and routine condition audits.
3. **Property Sales** (`/services#property-sales`): Strategic marketing, acquisition, title deed verification, and closing documentation for prime residential and commercial real estate.
4. **Property Valuation and Consultancy** (`/services#property-valuation`): Certified asset appraisals for mortgage collateral, statutory/insurance valuations, feasibility studies, and commercial lease advisory.
5. **Facility Management** (`/services#facility-management`): Integrated Total Facilities Management (TFM), HSE compliance, SLA vendor oversight, space planning, and asset lifecycle tracking.
6. **Building Maintenance and Repairs** (`/services#building-maintenance`): Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and 24/7 emergency repairs for electrical, plumbing, roofing, masonry, and carpentry systems.
7. **Estate Grounds and Landscaping Maintenance** (`/services#grounds-and-landscaping`): Horticultural care, lawn turf management, drainage de-silting, automated irrigation, and exterior pest control.
8. **Property Inspection and Refurbishment** (`/services#property-inspection-refurbishment`): Pre-purchase and pre-lease structural snagging audits, dampness diagnosis, and turnkey interior/exterior architectural renovations.
9. **Facility Installations and Coordination** (`/services#facility-installations-coordination`): Turnkey specification, installation, and commissioning of commercial generators, solar inverters, CCTV/biometrics, water treatment plants, and fire systems.
10. **Utilities and Facilities Operations Management** (`/services#utilities-operations-management`): Continuous management of central power distribution, diesel supply assurance, borehole water treatment, waste logistics, and smart energy sub-metering.
